title: A Network-Based Association of IBD and Colorectal Cancer Using Proteomics Data.
authors: Dhami, Jaiya; Radhakrishnan, Swarnima Kollampallath; Russ, Dominic; Mondal, Sudip; Alzarooni, Abdulrahman; Merodio, Laura Bravo; Duggal, Niharika A; Gupta, Ruchi; Acharjee, Animesh
one_liner_zh: 该文基于蛋白质组学数据构建IBD与CRC的互作网络，虽涉及转录因子-蛋白互作，但核心是疾病关联与生物标志物，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模及AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major cause of morbidity and mortality, with chronic inflammation from inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) representing a well-established risk factor. Clarifying shared molecular mechanisms may facilitate early detection and prevention strategies. METHODS: Proteomic data from the UK Biobank were analysed using the Olink proximity extension assay for seven CRC-associated proteins (TFF3, TFF1, AHCY, RETN, LCN2, SELE and CEACAM5) previously identified via machine learning. Expression levels in CRC and IBD cases were compared with controls. Multilayer interaction networks, incorporating protein-protein, protein-metabolite and transcription factor-protein interactions, were generated using OmicsNet. Findings were validated in the Colonomics transcriptomic dataset. RESULTS: All seven proteins were significantly upregulated in CRC; six (excluding CEACAM5) were also elevated in IBD. Network analysis identified AHCY and LCN2 as central hubs linking inflammatory and metabolic pathways. NF-kappaB and GATA2 emerged as recurrent transcriptional regulators. Colonomics validation confirmed upregulation of AHCY, LCN2 and SELE in CRC tissues. CONCLUSIONS: This multi-omics network analysis reveals a shared molecular framework between IBD and CRC, with inflammation as a key driver of colorectal carcinogenesis.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是发病率和死亡率的主要原因，炎症性肠病（IBD）引起的慢性炎症是公认的风险因素。阐明共享的分子机制可能有助于早期检测和预防策略。方法：利用UK Biobank的蛋白质组学数据，采用Olink邻近延伸法分析七种先前通过机器学习识别的CRC相关蛋白（TFF3、TFF1、AHCY、RETN、LCN2、SELE和CEACAM5）。比较CRC和IBD病例与对照组的表达水平。使用OmicsNet生成多层交互网络，包括蛋白质-蛋白质、蛋白质-代谢物和转录因子-蛋白质相互作用。研究结果在Colonomics转录组数据集中得到验证。结果：所有七种蛋白在CRC中均显著上调；其中六种（不包括CEACAM5）在IBD中也升高。网络分析确定AHCY和LCN2为连接炎症和代谢途径的中心枢纽。NF-kappaB和GATA2被识别为反复出现的转录调控因子。Colonomics验证确认了AHCY、LCN2和SELE在CRC组织中的上调。结论：这种多组学网络分析揭示了IBD和CRC之间的共享分子框架，其中炎症是结直肠癌发生的关键驱动因素。
